name: RAM/CPU + Wi-Fi indicators and day-of-week clock
description: Adds CPU/RAM ring meters and a Wi-Fi status button to the bar, gives the battery indicator a 3-stop red/orange/green colour ramp, and shows the day of the week next to the weather glyph in the clock. Includes an optional standalone thermometer-style TemperatureIndicator you can wire in yourself.
author: UjwalK2
permissions: Reads CPU/RAM/temperature stats from the existing SystemResources service
Reads Wi-Fi/network state from the existing NetworkService
